gyms.name: Solomon's Gold Mine
gyms.bio: Solomon’s Gold Mine is the pride project of bail bonds kingpin and jeweler Solomon Sanders. What started as an underground conditioning room behind his Tennessee pawn counters became a serious MMA pipeline—fighters with bite, grit, and debt to settle. The gym’s culture is simple: do the work, get paid, and leave a bigger mark than the bruises you take. Spars are mean, the conditioning is cruel, and nothing matters more than the purse. If you can’t survive the grind, you don’t belong in the Mine.

gyms.name: Henmaister's Sports Bar Gym
gyms.bio: Rumor says Henmaister made his bones running illegal pit fights in back rooms and basements. The regulars swear the smell of spilled beer and blood still clings to the bags. Discipline here is transactional—if it makes money, it’s on the table. Fighters learn to be durable, unflinching, and a little mean; his son Henz and the stable cut their teeth in those same pits. Henmaister’s motto isn’t subtle: more money, more problems—for someone else.

gyms.name: Vanishing Point
gyms.bio: No signage. No posted hours. You either know where Vanishing Point is, or you don’t. Grimm runs it like a ghost operation: sparse instruction, brutal sparring, and a focus on composure under pressure. The whispers about ties to the old SWA follow him—and when MommaSweet’s name drifts across the mat, sparring slows to a hush. Fighters here are tactical and unshakable, built to disappear from danger and reappear on the finish.

gyms.name: Da Hit Squad
gyms.bio: Run by the brash and broadcast-loud Rich Action, Da Hit Squad is all pressure and swagger. Spars feel like televised main events. Fighters learn to weaponize momentum—swarms of volume, clinch mauling, and knockout hunting. If you can’t keep up, you get drowned. If you can, you leave with a finish and a microphone.

gyms.name: The Yard
gyms.bio: The Yard is where second chances are bartered for blood. Warden Silas Griggs recruits the talented and the desperate with a simple deal: fight for me, earn for me, and your time gets easier. Training is harsh but honest—dirty-tough clinch wrestling, farm-strong conditioning, and survival instincts sharpened to a point. Nobody leaves The Yard soft.
